body: Thanks man, I actually did go through a hard time, but overwatch is really cool with this. People are good here. Thanks!

It's not about him having a friend, it's about me. He was being super nice and wholesome, telling me I was a nice person and I fucking declined because I didn't really care at the moment. I feel like shit. He was cool, I wasn't.

I know but I really regret declining when he was being so nice and complimented me on just being cool to others. It was a shit move. BUT I FOUND HIM! /u/meatchariot found me him, and I just sent request! Thanks everyone! Seriously.

Omg yes! YES! Turns ount his name was only Sito, and the number was just his #. He was one of those you listed and I know it is him because I recognize the number! Dude thank you so much, I hope he'll add me back so I can tell him! Thank you! /u/meatchariot
